title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Quickly check the current filters used on the current page via Page Inspection
summary: Page Inspection in Business Central allows you to quickly view all current filters applied to a page, including filters from the filter pane, list views, code, and subpage links. This feature helps identify hidden filters and understand their sources, accessible via Ctrl+Alt+F1 or the Help & Support menu.
key_points: Access page inspection using Ctrl+Alt+F1 keyboard shortcut or through Help & Support menu
Page Filters tab shows all filter types: user filters, table view filters, subform link filters, and form view filters
Identify filters that may not be visually displayed on the page and their sources
View mandatory filters created with Record.FilterGroup() method that users cannot remove
Security filters cannot be viewed using page inspection

quotes.text: This also allows you to identify filters that are not displayed on the page.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights a key benefit for troubleshooting and understanding actual page filtering behavior
